<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>🎯 Expectation Decider Project</title>
<style>
:root{--bg:#0d1117;--surface:#161b22;--surface2:#21262d;--border:#30363d;--accent:#58a6ff;--accent2:#f78166;--accent3:#3fb950;--accent4:#d2a8ff;--accent5:#ffa657;--text:#e6edf3;--muted:#8b949e;}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;line-height:1.6;max-width:960px;margin:0 auto;padding:40px 24px;}
.hero{text-align:center;padding:60px 20px 50px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%,#1f6feb22 0%,transparent 70%);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:16px;margin-bottom:40px;}
.hero-emoji{font-size:72px;display:block;margin-bottom:16px;}
.hero h1{font-size:2.8em;font-weight:800;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#58a6ff,#d2a8ff,#ffa657);-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;margin-bottom:12px;}
.hero .subtitle{color:var(--muted);font-size:1.1em;margin-bottom:24px;}
.badges{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;justify-content:center;}
.badge{padding:4px 14px;border-radius:20px;font-size:.8em;font-weight:600;border:1px solid;}
.badge-blue{background:#1f6feb22;border-color:#58a6ff;color:#58a6ff;}
.badge-green{background:#23863622;border-color:#3fb950;color:#3fb950;}
.badge-purple{background:#6e40c922;border-color:#d2a8ff;color:#d2a8ff;}
.badge-orange{background:#ffa65722;border-color:#ffa657;color:#ffa657;}
.badge-red{background:#f7816622;border-color:#f78166;color:#f78166;}
section{margin-bottom:40px;}
h2{font-size:1.5em;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:14px 20px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-left:4px solid var(--accent);border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:20px;}
h3{font-size:1.1em;font-weight:600;color:var(--accent4);margin:16px 0 10px;}
p{color:#c9d1d9;margin-bottom:12px;}
.card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:20px 24px;margin-bottom:16px;}
.card-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(180px,1fr));gap:14px;margin-bottom:20px;}
.stat-card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:18px;text-align:center;transition:transform .2s,border-color .2s;}
.stat-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--accent);}
.stat-card .icon{font-size:32px;margin-bottom:8px;}
.stat-card .label{font-size:.85em;color:var(--muted);}
.stat-card .value{font-size:1.05em;font-weight:700;}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;background:var(--surface);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--border);margin-bottom:20px;}
th{background:var(--surface2);padding:12px 16px;text-align:left;font-weight:600;color:var(--accent);font-size:.9em;}
td{padding:12px 16px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);color:#c9d1d9;font-size:.95em;}
tr:hover td{background:var(--surface2);}
code{background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:2px 8px;border-radius:6px;font-family:monospace;font-size:.88em;color:#f78166;}
pre{background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:18px 20px;overflow-x:auto;margin:12px 0;}
pre code{background:none;border:none;padding:0;color:#e6edf3;font-size:.9em;}
.concept-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(210px,1fr));gap:10px;}
.concept-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;font-size:.92em;transition:border-color .2s;}
.concept-item:hover{border-color:var(--accent4);}
.concept-num{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6e40c9,#d2a8ff);color:white;font-weight:700;font-size:.8em;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;}
.formula{background:#1c2128;border:1px solid #388bfd44;border-left:3px solid var(--accent);border-radius:8px;padding:14px 18px;font-family:monospace;font-size:.95em;color:#79c0ff;margin:10px 0;}
.two-col{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;}
.viz-card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:24px;transition:border-color .2s,transform .2s;}
.viz-card:hover{border-color:#388bfd;transform:translateY(-2px);}
.viz-header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:16px 20px;background:var(--surface2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
.viz-header .num{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1f6feb,#388bfd);color:white;font-weight:800;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:.85em;flex-shrink:0;}
.viz-header .vtitle{font-weight:700;font-size:1em;}
.viz-body{padding:20px;}
.viz-body img{width:100%;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--border);margin:14px 0;display:block;}
.obs-box{background:#1c2128;border:1px solid #3fb95033;border-left:3px solid var(--accent3);border-radius:8px;padding:12px 16px;margin:10px 0;font-size:.92em;}
.obs-box strong{color:var(--accent3);display:block;margin-bottom:4px;}
.learn-box{background:#1c2128;border:1px solid #d2a8ff33;border-left:3px solid var(--accent4);border-radius:8px;padding:12px 16px;margin:10px 0;font-size:.92em;}
.learn-box strong{color:var(--accent4);display:block;margin-bottom:4px;}
.callout{background:#1f6feb11;border:1px solid #58a6ff44;border-radius:10px;padding:16px 20px;margin:16px 0;font-style:italic;color:#79c0ff;font-size:.95em;}
.conclusion{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1f6feb11,#3fb95011,#d2a8ff11);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;padding:30px;text-align:center;}
.factor-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(190px,1fr));gap:12px;margin:20px 0;}
.factor{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid #3fb95044;border-radius:10px;padding:14px;font-size:.92em;}
.factor .check{color:var(--accent3);font-size:1.3em;}
.footer{text-align:center;padding:30px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;margin-top:40px;}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="hero">
  <span class="hero-emoji">🎯</span>
  <h1>Expectation Decider</h1>
  <p class="subtitle">📊 Probability + Statistics Based Student Performance Analysis</p>
  <div class="badges">
    <span class="badge badge-blue">🐍 Python</span>
    <span class="badge badge-green">📈 Matplotlib</span>
    <span class="badge badge-purple">🧮 Statistics</span>
    <span class="badge badge-orange">📦 Pandas</span>
    <span class="badge badge-red">🎓 Education</span>
    <span class="badge badge-blue">👥 200 Students</span>
  </div>
</div>

<section>
  <h2>🌟 Why I Made This Project?</h2>
  <div class="card">
    <p>Is project ka goal tha student ke exam pass hone ki probability analyze karna using real student data.</p>
    <div class="callout">💡 Kaunse factors student ke pass hone ko affect karte hai?</div>
    <p>Maine probability, statistics aur visualization use karke full analysis kiya — from raw data to meaningful insights.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="card-grid">
    <div class="stat-card"><div class="icon">📚</div><div class="value">Study Hours</div><div class="label">Weekly study time</div></div>
    <div class="stat-card"><div class="icon">🏫</div><div class="value">Attendance</div><div class="label">Lecture % attended</div></div>
    <div class="stat-card"><div class="icon">🤝</div><div class="value">Group Discussion</div><div class="label">Participation flag</div></div>
    <div class="stat-card"><div class="icon">📝</div><div class="value">Prev. Score</div><div class="label">Internal exam marks</div></div>
  </div>
</section>

<section>
  <h2>📂 Dataset Information</h2>
  <div class="card">
    <p>Dataset me <strong style="color:var(--accent)">200 students</strong> ka data hai:</p>
    <table>
      <thead><tr><th>Column Name</th><th>Meaning</th><th>Type</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr><td><code>study_hours</code></td><td>Week me kitne hours study ki</td><td>Numeric</td></tr>
        <tr><td><code>attendance</code></td><td>Lecture attendance percentage</td><td>Numeric</td></tr>
        <tr><td><code>group_discussion</code></td><td>Discussion me participate kiya ya nahi</td><td>Binary</td></tr>
        <tr><td><code>previous_test_score</code></td><td>Previous internal exam marks</td><td>Numeric</td></tr>
        <tr><td><code>final_exam_pass</code></td><td>Final exam me pass/fail</td><td>🎯 Target</td></tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
</section>

<section>
  <h2>🧠 Concepts Covered</h2>
  <div class="concept-list">
    <div class="concept-item"><div class="concept-num">1</div>Probability Basics</div>
    <div class="concept-item"><div class="concept-num">2</div>Types of Events</div>
    <div class="concept-item"><div class="concept-num">3</div>Empirical vs Theoretical</div>
    <div class="concept-item"><div class="concept-num">4</div>Random Variable</div>
    <div class="concept-item"><div class="concept-num">5</div>Probability Distribution</div>
    <div class="concept-item"><div class="concept-num">6</div>Mean &amp; Variance</div>
    <div class="concept-item"><div class="concept-num">7</div>Venn Diagram</div>
    <div class="concept-item"><div class="concept-num">8</div>Contingency Table</div>
    <div class="concept-item"><div class="concept-num">9</div>Joint / Marginal / Conditional</div>
    <div class="concept-item"><div class="concept-num">10</div>Independent vs Dependent</div>
    <div class="concept-item"><div class="concept-num">11</div>Bayes Theorem</div>
  </div>
</section>

<section>
  <h2>1️⃣ Probability Basics</h2>
  <div class="card">
    <h3>🎲 What is Probability?</h3>
    <p>Kisi event ke hone ki possibility. Range: 0 (impossible) → 1 (certain).</p>
    <div class="formula">P(E) = Favorable Outcomes / Total Outcomes</div>
    <div class="formula">P(Pass) = No. of students passed / Total students</div>
  </div>
  <div class="card">
    <table>
      <thead><tr><th>Term</th><th>Meaning</th><th>Example</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr><td>🧪 Experiment</td><td>Activity jisme outcome mile</td><td>Exam conduct karna</td></tr>
        <tr><td>📤 Outcome</td><td>Experiment ka result</td><td>Pass / Fail</td></tr>
        <tr><td>📌 Event</td><td>Specific condition</td><td>Study &gt;10 hrs/week</td></tr>
        <tr><td>🌍 Sample Space</td><td>All possible outcomes</td><td>S = {Pass, Fail}</td></tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
</section>

<section>
  <h2>2️⃣ Types of Probability</h2>
  <div class="two-col">
    <div class="card">
      <h3>🔬 Empirical</h3>
      <p>Real dataset use karke.</p>
      <div class="formula">P(E) = Favorable / Total</div>
    </div>
    <div class="card">
      <h3>📐 Theoretical</h3>
      <p>Mathematical assumption based.</p>
      <div class="formula">P(Pass) = 1/2</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section>
  <h2>3️⃣ Random Variable &amp; Distribution</h2>
  <div class="card">
    <div class="formula">X = Students passing out of 3 randomly selected<br>Possible: 0, 1, 2, 3</div>
  </div>
  <div class="two-col">
    <div class="card"><h3>📊 Mean</h3><div class="formula">E(X) = Σ x · P(x)</div></div>
    <div class="card"><h3>📉 Variance</h3><div class="formula">Var(X) = E(X²) − [E(X)]²</div></div>
  </div>
</section>


<section>
  <h2>4️⃣ Probability Distribution</h2>
  <div class="card">
    <p>Probability distribution table banayi thi — har outcome ki probability dekhne ke liye.</p>
    <table>
      <thead><tr><th>X (Outcome)</th><th>Probability</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr><td>X = 0</td><td>P(X=0)</td></tr>
        <tr><td>X = 1</td><td>P(X=1)</td></tr>
        <tr><td>X = 2</td><td>P(X=2)</td></tr>
        <tr><td>X = 3</td><td>P(X=3)</td></tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
    <p style="color:var(--muted);font-size:.9em;">X = Number of students passing out of 3 randomly selected students.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="two-col">
    <div class="card">
      <h3>📊 Mean (Expected Value)</h3>
      <div class="formula">E(X) = Σ x · P(x)</div>
      <p style="color:var(--muted);font-size:.88em;">Average expected value — kitne students pass honge on average.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="card">
      <h3>📉 Variance</h3>
      <div class="formula">Var(X) = E(X²) − [E(X)]²</div>
      <p style="color:var(--muted);font-size:.88em;">Data kitna spread hai — spread of outcomes measure karna.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section>
  <h2>5️⃣ Venn Diagram ⭕</h2>
  <div class="card">
    <p>Overlap check karne ke liye — do sets ke beech common students kaun hain.</p>
    <div class="two-col">
      <div class="card" style="background:var(--surface2);">
        <h3 style="color:#f78166;">🔴 Set A</h3>
        <div class="formula">Study Hours &gt; 10 hrs/week</div>
      </div>
      <div class="card" style="background:var(--surface2);">
        <h3 style="color:#3fb950;">🟢 Set B</h3>
        <div class="formula">Attendance &gt; 80%</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="obs-box" style="margin-top:12px;">
      <strong>⭕ Overlap (A ∩ B)</strong>
      Students who satisfy BOTH conditions — high study hours AND high attendance.<br>
      <span style="color:var(--accent);font-weight:600;">P(A ∩ B) = 32/200 = 0.16</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section>
  <h2>6️⃣ Contingency Table 📋</h2>
  <div class="card">
    <p>Comparison kiya between <code>group_discussion</code> vs <code>final_exam_pass</code> — check karna ki discussion participation pass hone me help karti hai ya nahi.</p>
    <table>
      <thead><tr><th>Probability Type</th><th>Meaning</th><th>Formula</th><th>Example</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr>
          <td><strong style="color:var(--accent)">Joint Probability</strong></td>
          <td>Dono events ek saath</td>
          <td><code>P(A ∩ B)</code></td>
          <td>Student discusses AND passes</td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td><strong style="color:var(--accent3)">Marginal Probability</strong></td>
          <td>Single event ki probability</td>
          <td><code>P(A)</code></td>
          <td>P(Pass) overall</td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td><strong style="color:var(--accent4)">Conditional Probability</strong></td>
          <td>Ek event given dusra</td>
          <td><code>P(A|B) = P(A∩B)/P(B)</code></td>
          <td>P(Pass | participated in discussion)</td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
    <div class="formula">P(A|B) = P(A ∩ B) / P(B)</div>
  </div>
</section>

<section>
  <h2>7️⃣ Relationship Between Variables 🔗</h2>
  <div class="card">
    <p>Yaha check kiya: <code>group_discussion</code> aur <code>final_exam_pass</code> — <strong>Independent hai ya Dependent?</strong></p>
    <div class="two-col">
      <div class="card" style="background:var(--surface2);border-color:#3fb95044;">
        <h3 style="color:var(--accent3);">✅ Dependent Events</h3>
        <p style="font-size:.9em;">Discussion participation pass hone ko influence kar sakta hai — ek event dusre ko affect karta hai.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="card" style="background:var(--surface2);border-color:#f7816644;">
        <h3 style="color:#f78166;">❌ NOT Mutually Exclusive</h3>
        <p style="font-size:.9em;">Student discussion bhi kar sakta hai aur pass bhi ho sakta hai — dono ek saath possible hain.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="obs-box" style="margin-top:4px;">
      <strong>📌 Final Understanding</strong>
      group_discussion and final_exam_pass are <strong>Dependent</strong> events — discussion participation influences passing probability.
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
<section>
  <h2>8️⃣ Bayes Theorem 🔄</h2>
  <div class="card">
    <p><em>High attendance hone par pass hone ki probability kitni hai?</em></p>
    <div class="formula">P(A|B) = P(B|A) × P(A) / P(B)</div>
    <table>
      <thead><tr><th>Fact</th><th>Value</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr><td>Passing students with high attendance</td><td>70%</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Failing students with high attendance</td><td>40%</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Students with high attendance overall</td><td>60%</td></tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
</section>

<section>
  <h2>📊 Visualizations</h2>

  <div class="viz-card">
    <div class="viz-header">
      <div class="num">1</div>
      <div class="vtitle">📊 Final Exam Pass Distribution — Bar Chart</div>
    </div>
    <div class="viz-body">
      <p>Kitne students pass hue aur kitne fail hue ka comparison.</p>
      <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Pass/Fail Bar Chart">
      <div class="obs-box"><strong>📌 Observation</strong>Pass students zyada hai — Fail students comparatively kam hai.</div>
      <div class="learn-box"><strong>🧠 What I Learned</strong>Dataset me majority students pass hue, passing probability higher rakhi gayi hai.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="viz-card">
    <div class="viz-header">
      <div class="num">2</div>
      <div class="vtitle">📈 Study Hours Distribution — Histogram</div>
    </div>
    <div class="viz-body">
      <p>Students generally kitna study karte hai — distribution aur spread samajhna.</p>
      <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Study Hours Histogram">
      <div class="obs-box"><strong>📌 Observation</strong>Most students middle range me hai (~8–12 hrs/week), peak around 10 hours.</div>
      <div class="learn-box"><strong>🧠 What I Learned</strong>Histogram se study pattern aur spread clearly samajh aata hai.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="viz-card">
    <div class="viz-header">
      <div class="num">3</div>
      <div class="vtitle">🔵 Attendance vs Previous Score — Scatter Plot</div>
    </div>
    <div class="viz-body">
      <p>Attendance aur previous test score ka relationship check karna.</p>
      <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Scatter Plot">
      <div class="obs-box"><strong>📌 Observation</strong>Higher attendance wale students ka score generally better tha — positive correlation visible.</div>
      <div class="learn-box"><strong>🧠 What I Learned</strong>Attendance academic performance ko influence kar sakti hai.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="viz-card">
    <div class="viz-header">
      <div class="num">4</div>
      <div class="vtitle">⭕ Study &amp; Attendance Overlap — Venn Diagram</div>
    </div>
    <div class="viz-body">
      <p>Overlap check karna between Study &gt;10 hrs AND Attendance &gt;80%.</p>
      <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Venn Diagram">
      <div class="obs-box"><strong>📌 Observation</strong>52 only study | 39 only attendance | <strong>32 students satisfy BOTH</strong> conditions.</div>
      <div class="learn-box"><strong>🧠 What I Learned</strong>P(A ∩ B) = 32/200 = 0.16 — Intersection probability practically samaj aayi.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

</section>

<section>
  <h2>🛠️ Libraries Used</h2>
  <div class="card-grid">
    <div class="stat-card"><div class="icon">🐼</div><div class="value">pandas</div><div class="label">Data manipulation</div></div>
    <div class="stat-card"><div class="icon">🔢</div><div class="value">numpy</div><div class="label">Numerical computing</div></div>
    <div class="stat-card"><div class="icon">📊</div><div class="value">matplotlib</div><div class="label">Core plotting</div></div>
    <div class="stat-card"><div class="icon">🎨</div><div class="value">seaborn</div><div class="label">Statistical viz</div></div>
    <div class="stat-card"><div class="icon">⭕</div><div class="value">mpl-venn</div><div class="label">Venn diagrams</div></div>
  </div>
  <pre><code>pip install pandas numpy matplotlib seaborn matplotlib-venn</code></pre>
</section>

<section>
  <h2>🚀 How to Run</h2>
  <div class="card">
    <p>Open the Jupyter notebook and run all cells:</p>
    <pre><code>Expectation_Decider_Project_Charts.ipynb</code></pre>
  </div>
</section>

<section>
  <h2>💡 Key Learnings</h2>
  <div class="card">
    <div class="concept-list">
      <div class="concept-item">✅ Probability real dataset par apply hoti hai</div>
      <div class="concept-item">✅ Empirical vs Theoretical practically</div>
      <div class="concept-item">✅ Conditional probability use case</div>
      <div class="concept-item">✅ Bayes theorem real application</div>
      <div class="concept-item">✅ Venn diagram me intersection</div>
      <div class="concept-item">✅ Contingency table relationships</div>
      <div class="concept-item">✅ Statistical visualization power</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="conclusion">
  <h2 style="justify-content:center;background:none;border:none;padding:0;margin-bottom:16px;">🏁 Final Conclusion</h2>
  <p style="color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:20px;">Analysis ke hisab se, ye factors increase karte hai pass probability:</p>
  <div class="factor-grid">
    <div class="factor"><div class="check">✅</div>Higher Study Hours</div>
    <div class="factor"><div class="check">✅</div>Better Attendance</div>
    <div class="factor"><div class="check">✅</div>Group Discussion</div>
    <div class="factor"><div class="check">✅</div>Good Previous Score</div>
  </div>
  <div style="background:#1f6feb11;border:1px solid #58a6ff44;border-radius:10px;padding:16px 20px;margin:16px auto;max-width:600px;color:#79c0ff;">
    🎓 Consistent study + good attendance + participation = higher chance of passing!
  </div>
